titolo: Introducing the llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
descr: The new dashboard lets developers compare prompt processing and text generation speeds of llama.cpp models on Radeon 8060S and AI Pro R9700S.
paragrafi: Hugging Face released a llama.cpp benchmark dashboard on November 26, 2026.
The tool tracks token‑per‑second performance for prompt processing (PP512) and text generation (TG128) across different llama.cpp builds, models and quantizations.
Users can select a model, build and quantization in a sidebar.
Benchmarks run weekly using llama‑bench with Flash Attention on and off, ten repetitions per configuration, and results are stored publicly on Hugging Face.
Supported models include Inkling 2 Mini, Qwen, Gemma, gpt‑oss and LFM, with GGUF formats such as Q4_K_M, Q8_0, BF16 and F16.
perche: The open data also supports the free‑model community by providing reference numbers for running models locally without cloud services.
